data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): Module purpose expanded — also defines (a) MutationDirection and MutationAction enums (these were originally going to live in draft-1's mutation.py but per task-3 needs they may also need to be importable here; coordinate ownership between mutation.py and _errors.py — single source of truth). (b) RETRY_BUDGET: int = 3 module-level constant (matches current _call_with_retry max_retries default). Final placement: enums in mutation.py (draft-1, already created); RETRY_BUDGET here in _errors.py (or rename _errors.py -> _domain.py). Reconcile naming choice with task-3.
